releaseNotes: Unified MR Location Attribution: Resolved dashboard-mobile attribution conflict so Kotma locations correctly reflect Field MR discovery by Amar Dwivedi with route circuits across all admin and mobile views

Strict MR Location Isolation: Field Representatives strictly only view and manage locations and doctors marked by or assigned to them in the mobile directory and maps, with territory stats accurately reflecting only their own facilities
Route Batch Circuit Selector on Map: Field Representatives can directly select and link a route batch circuit when marking or updating any facility location
Doctor Directory Route Circuit Badges: Doctor & facility directory displays assigned travel circuits with one-tap batch assignment
Authentic MR Location Attribution: Locations marked by Field MRs are properly attributed with their authentic name & ID and isolated in territory views
Out-of-Stock Order Visibility: Orders containing out-of-stock items remain visible with warnings instead of being hidden
Multi-Location Tour Planning: Monthly TP allows selecting multiple pinned locations per day/date with automatic sequence ordering
TP-Driven Geofenced Task Sequencing: Approved tour plans automatically generate sequenced daily tasks with 50-meter geofence enforcement
